create_constant_schedule: create a constant schedule that returns the same learning rate value at every step
create_cosine_decay_schedule: create a cosine decay schedule that decays a value from initial to zero over a number of steps
create_piecewise_constant_schedule: create a piecewise constant schedule that changes values at specified step boundaries
create_join_schedules: join two schedules together at a boundary step to switch from one schedule to another
create_warmup_cosine_decay_schedule: create a warmup cosine decay schedule that warms up then decays using cosine annealing
